scripts.title: GRATIS FREECAM!!
scripts.script:
-- Wait for game to load properly
if not game:IsLoaded() then
	game.Loaded:Wait()
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Cleanup precedenti
local oldGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("XenoFreecamNotification")
if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

-- Settings
local baseSpeed = 50
local isFreecamActive = false
local cameraCFrame = CFrame.new()
local targetVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
local currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
local cameraYaw = 0
local cameraPitch = 0
local sensitivity = 0.3

-- Notifica GUI (Scale Only)
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "XenoFreecamNotification"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local notificationFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
notificationFrame.Name = "NotificationFrame"
notificationFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.22, 0, 0.06, 0)
notificationFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.76, 0, 0.9, 0)
notificationFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
notificationFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
notificationFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
notificationFrame.Parent = screenGui

local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.2, 0)
uiCorner.Parent = notificationFrame

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Name = "StatusLabel"
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.8, 0)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.1, 0)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75)
statusLabel.TextScaled = true
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
statusLabel.Text = "Freecam: OFF (Shift + P)"
statusLabel.Parent = notificationFrame

-- Controlli Tasti
local keysPressed = {
	W = false,
	A = false,
	S = false,
	D = false,
	E = false,
	Q = false
}

local function setCharacterVisibility(visible)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Decal") then
			if part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
				part.LocalTransparencyModifier = visible and 0 or 1
			end
		end
	end
end

local function toggleFreecam()
	isFreecamActive = not isFreecamActive

	if isFreecamActive then
		statusLabel.Text = "Freecam: ON"
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 255, 120)

		cameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
		local x, y, _ = cameraCFrame:ToOrientation()
		cameraPitch = x
		cameraYaw = y

		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
		
		if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = true
		end
		
		setCharacterVisibility(false)
	else
		statusLabel.Text = "Freecam: OFF (Shift + P)"
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75)

		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		
		if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
		end
		
		setCharacterVisibility(true)
		targetVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
end

-- Gestione Input Mouse
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if not isFreecamActive then return end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		local delta = input.Delta
		cameraYaw = cameraYaw - math.rad(delta.X * sensitivity)
		cameraPitch = math.clamp(cameraPitch - math.rad(delta.Y * sensitivity), math.rad(-89), math.rad(89))
	end
end)

-- Gestione Input Tastiera
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	-- Pressione Shift + P
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) then
			toggleFreecam()
			return
		end
	end

	if isFreecamActive then
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then keysPressed.W = true end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then keysPressed.A = true end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then keysPressed.S = true end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then keysPressed.D = true end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then keysPressed.E = true end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then keysPressed.Q = true end
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then keysPressed.W = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then keysPressed.A = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then keysPressed.S = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then keysPressed.D = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then keysPressed.E = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then keysPressed.Q = false end
end)

-- Loop di rendering
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	if not isFreecamActive then return end

	setCharacterVisibility(false)
	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter

	local rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, cameraYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(cameraPitch, 0, 0)

	local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	if keysPressed.W then moveDir = moveDir + rotation.LookVector end
	if keysPressed.S then moveDir = moveDir - rotation.LookVector end
	if keysPressed.D then moveDir = moveDir + rotation.RightVector end
	if keysPressed.A then moveDir = moveDir - rotation.RightVector end
	if keysPressed.E then moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
	if keysPressed.Q then moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

	if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
		moveDir = moveDir.Unit
	end

	targetVelocity = moveDir * baseSpeed
	currentVelocity = currentVelocity:Lerp(targetVelocity, math.clamp(dt * 10, 0, 1))

	local currentPosition = cameraCFrame.Position + (currentVelocity * dt)
	cameraCFrame = CFrame.new(currentPosition) * rotation
	camera.CFrame = cameraCFrame
end)

scripts.script:
--========================================================
-- EVADE AFK
--
-- RightShift = Open / close menu
-- P          = Toggle orbit
--
-- ONLY:
--   1. Orbit
--   2. Auto Revive
--
-- Orbit persists through character respawns.
--========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--========================================================
-- SETTINGS
--========================================================

local ORBIT_RADIUS = 30
local ORBIT_SPEED = 2
local ORBIT_HEIGHT = 500000

local REVIVE_OFFSET = -5
local REVIVE_HOLD_TIME = 15

--========================================================
-- STATE
--========================================================

local OrbitEnabled = false
local AutoReviveEnabled = false

local OrbitAngle = 0
local OrbitOrigin = nil

local Reviving = false
local CurrentPrompt = nil

--========================================================
-- CHARACTER
--========================================================

local function GetCharacter()

	local Character = Player.Character

	if not Character then
		return nil
	end

	local Root =
		Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local Humanoid =
		Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not Root or not Humanoid then
		return nil
	end

	return Character, Root, Humanoid
end

--========================================================
-- REMOVE OLD UI
--========================================================

local OldGUI =
	PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("EvadeAFK")

if OldGUI then
	OldGUI:Destroy()
end

--========================================================
-- GUI
--========================================================

local GUI = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

GUI.Name = "EvadeAFK"
GUI.ResetOnSpawn = false
GUI.IgnoreGuiInset = true
GUI.DisplayOrder = 999999
GUI.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
GUI.Parent = PlayerGui

local Main = Instance.new("Frame")

Main.Name = "Main"

Main.Size =
	UDim2.fromOffset(330, 220)

Main.Position =
	UDim2.new(
		0.5,
		-165,
		0.5,
		-110
	)

Main.BackgroundColor3 =
	Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 18)

Main.BorderSizePixel = 0
Main.Visible = false
Main.ZIndex = 100

Main.Parent = GUI

local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

Corner.CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(0, 14)

Corner.Parent = Main

local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

Stroke.Color =
	Color3.fromRGB(135, 65, 255)

Stroke.Thickness = 2
Stroke.Parent = Main

--========================================================
-- TITLE
--========================================================

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")

Title.Size =
	UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 55)

Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1

Title.Text = "EVADE AFK"

Title.TextColor3 =
	Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

Title.Font =
	Enum.Font.GothamBold

Title.TextSize = 24
Title.ZIndex = 101

Title.Parent = Main

--========================================================
-- BUTTON CREATOR
--========================================================

local function CreateButton(Text, Y)

	local Button =
		Instance.new("TextButton")

	Button.Position =
		UDim2.fromOffset(20, Y)

	Button.Size =
		UDim2.new(
			1,
			-40,
			0,
			45
		)

	Button.BackgroundColor3 =
		Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)

	Button.BorderSizePixel = 0

	Button.Text = Text

	Button.TextColor3 =
		Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

	Button.Font =
		Enum.Font.GothamBold

	Button.TextSize = 14

	Button.ZIndex = 101

	Button.Parent = Main

	local ButtonCorner =
		Instance.new("UICorner")

	ButtonCorner.CornerRadius =
		UDim.new(0, 10)

	ButtonCorner.Parent =
		Button

	return Button
end

--========================================================
-- BUTTONS
--========================================================

local OrbitButton =
	CreateButton(
		"ORBIT: OFF",
		65
	)

local ReviveButton =
	CreateButton(
		"AUTO REVIVE: OFF",
		120
	)

--========================================================
-- INFO
--========================================================

local Info = Instance.new("TextLabel")

Info.Position =
	UDim2.fromOffset(10, 172)

Info.Size =
	UDim2.new(
		1,
		-20,
		0,
		35
	)

Info.BackgroundTransparency = 1

Info.Text =
	"Right Shift = Menu  •  P = Orbit"

Info.TextColor3 =
	Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)

Info.Font =
	Enum.Font.Gotham

Info.TextSize = 12

Info.ZIndex = 101

Info.Parent = Main

--========================================================
-- UI UPDATE
--========================================================

local function UpdateUI()

	if OrbitEnabled then

		OrbitButton.Text =
			"ORBIT: ON [P]"

		OrbitButton.BackgroundColor3 =
			Color3.fromRGB(105, 55, 210)

	else

		OrbitButton.Text =
			"ORBIT: OFF [P]"

		OrbitButton.BackgroundColor3 =
			Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)

	end

	if AutoReviveEnabled then

		if Reviving then

			ReviveButton.Text =
				"AUTO REVIVE: REVIVING..."

		else

			ReviveButton.Text =
				"AUTO REVIVE: ON"

		end

		ReviveButton.BackgroundColor3 =
			Color3.fromRGB(45, 150, 90)

	else

		ReviveButton.Text =
			"AUTO REVIVE: OFF"

		ReviveButton.BackgroundColor3 =
			Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)

	end
end

--========================================================
-- DOWNED DETECTION
--========================================================

local function IsDowned(Character)

	if not Character then
		return false
	end

	-- Attributes

	if Character:GetAttribute("Downed") == true then
		return true
	end

	if Character:GetAttribute("downed") == true then
		return true
	end

	if Character:GetAttribute("DBNO") == true then
		return true
	end

	-- BoolValues

	for _, Name in ipairs({
		"Downed",
		"downed",
		"DBNO",
		"Knocked",
		"knocked"
	}) do

		local Value =
			Character:FindFirstChild(Name)

		if Value
			and Value:IsA("BoolValue")
			and Value.Value
		then

			return true

		end
	end

	return false
end

--========================================================
-- FIND E PROMPT
--========================================================

local function FindEPrompt(Character)

	if not Character then
		return nil
	end

	for _, Object in ipairs(
		Character:GetDescendants()
	) do

		if Object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			and Object.Enabled
			and Object.KeyboardKeyCode ==
				Enum.KeyCode.E
		then

			return Object

		end
	end

	return nil
end

--========================================================
-- FIND DOWNED PLAYER
--========================================================

local function FindDownedPlayer()

	local MyCharacter, MyRoot =
		GetCharacter()

	if not MyRoot then
		return nil
	end

	local ClosestPlayer = nil
	local ClosestDistance = math.huge

	for _, Target in ipairs(
		Players:GetPlayers()
	) do

		if Target ~= Player then

			local Character =
				Target.Character

			if Character
				and IsDowned(Character)
			then

				local Root =
					Character:
					FindFirstChild(
						"HumanoidRootPart"
					)

				if Root then

					local Distance =
						(
							Root.Position -
							MyRoot.Position
						).Magnitude

					if Distance <
						ClosestDistance
					then

						ClosestDistance =
							Distance

						ClosestPlayer =
							Target

					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return ClosestPlayer
end

--========================================================
-- ORBIT
--========================================================

local function StartOrbit()

	local Character, Root =
		GetCharacter()

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	OrbitOrigin =
		Root.Position

	OrbitAngle = 0

	OrbitEnabled = true

	UpdateUI()
end

local function StopOrbit()

	OrbitEnabled = false

	local Character, Root, Humanoid =
		GetCharacter()

	if Root then

		Root.Anchored = false

		Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
			Vector3.zero

		Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
			Vector3.zero

	end

	if Humanoid then
		Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end

	UpdateUI()
end

local function ToggleOrbit()

	if OrbitEnabled then
		StopOrbit()
	else
		StartOrbit()
	end
end

--========================================================
-- ORBIT LOOP
--========================================================

RunService.RenderStepped:
Connect(function(DT)

	if not OrbitEnabled then
		return
	end

	-- Revive gets priority.

	if Reviving then
		return
	end

	local Character,
		Root,
		Humanoid =
		GetCharacter()

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	-- If character respawned,
	-- recreate an origin automatically.

	if not OrbitOrigin then

		OrbitOrigin =
			Root.Position

	end

	Root.Anchored = true

	Humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	OrbitAngle +=
		ORBIT_SPEED * DT

	local Center =
		OrbitOrigin
		+
		Vector3.new(
			0,
			ORBIT_HEIGHT,
			0
		)

	local Offset =
		Vector3.new(
			math.cos(OrbitAngle)
				* ORBIT_RADIUS,

			0,

			math.sin(OrbitAngle)
				* ORBIT_RADIUS
		)

	Root.CFrame =
		CFrame.new(
			Center + Offset
		)
		*
		CFrame.Angles(
			0,
			-OrbitAngle,
			0
		)

end)

--========================================================
-- AUTO REVIVE
--========================================================

task.spawn(function()

	while GUI.Parent do

		task.wait(0.1)

		if not AutoReviveEnabled then
			continue
		end

		if Reviving then
			continue
		end

		local Target =
			FindDownedPlayer()

		if not Target then
			continue
		end

		local TargetCharacter =
			Target.Character

		if not TargetCharacter then
			continue
		end

		local TargetRoot =
			TargetCharacter:
			FindFirstChild(
				"HumanoidRootPart"
			)

		if not TargetRoot then
			continue
		end

		local Prompt =
			FindEPrompt(
				TargetCharacter
			)

		if not Prompt then
			continue
		end

		local MyCharacter,
			MyRoot,
			MyHumanoid =
			GetCharacter()

		if not MyRoot then
			continue
		end

		--============================================
		-- START REVIVE
		--============================================

		Reviving = true

		UpdateUI()

		MyRoot.Anchored = false

		MyRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
			Vector3.zero

		MyRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
			Vector3.zero

		-- Start holding E.

		CurrentPrompt = Prompt

		Prompt:InputHoldBegin()

		local StartTime =
			os.clock()

		--============================================
		-- HOLD FOR 15 SECONDS
		--============================================

		while
			AutoReviveEnabled
			and
			(os.clock() - StartTime)
				< REVIVE_HOLD_TIME
		do

			-- Target disappeared?

			if not TargetCharacter.Parent then
				break
			end

			TargetRoot =
				TargetCharacter:
				FindFirstChild(
					"HumanoidRootPart"
				)

			if not TargetRoot then
				break
			end

			if not MyRoot.Parent then
				break
			end

			-- Stay exactly 5 studs
			-- underneath them.

			MyRoot.CFrame =
				TargetRoot.CFrame
				*
				CFrame.new(
					0,
					REVIVE_OFFSET,
					0
				)

			MyRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
				Vector3.zero

			MyRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
				Vector3.zero

			RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end

		--============================================
		-- RELEASE E
		--============================================

		pcall(function()

			Prompt:InputHoldEnd()

		end)

		CurrentPrompt = nil

		Reviving = false

		--============================================
		-- RETURN TO ORBIT
		--============================================

		if OrbitEnabled then

			local Character,
				NewRoot =
				GetCharacter()

			if NewRoot then

				NewRoot.Anchored =
					true

			end
		end

		UpdateUI()

		-- Small delay before finding
		-- another downed player.

		task.wait(0.1)

	end

end)

--========================================================
-- BUTTONS
--========================================================

OrbitButton.MouseButton1Click:
Connect(function()

	ToggleOrbit()

end)

ReviveButton.MouseButton1Click:
Connect(function()

	AutoReviveEnabled =
		not AutoReviveEnabled

	-- Immediately release E
	-- if user disables Auto Revive.

	if not AutoReviveEnabled
		and CurrentPrompt
	then

		pcall(function()

			CurrentPrompt:
				InputHoldEnd()

		end)

		CurrentPrompt = nil
		Reviving = false

	end

	UpdateUI()

end)

--========================================================
-- KEYBINDS
--========================================================

UIS.InputBegan:
Connect(function(Input, Processed)

	-- RIGHT SHIFT ALWAYS TOGGLES MENU

	if Input.KeyCode ==
		Enum.KeyCode.RightShift
	then

		Main.Visible =
			not Main.Visible

		return
	end

	if Processed then
		return
	end

	-- P = ORBIT

	if Input.KeyCode ==
		Enum.KeyCode.P
	then

		ToggleOrbit()

	end

end)

--========================================================
-- ROUND / RESPAWN HANDLING
--========================================================

Player.CharacterAdded:
Connect(function(Character)

	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- Do NOT change OrbitEnabled here.
	-- Do NOT change AutoReviveEnabled here.
	--
	-- Therefore a respawn/round reset
	-- doesn't disable either feature.

	Reviving = false
	CurrentPrompt = nil

	local Root =
		Character:
		WaitForChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart",
			10
		)

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	-- New origin for new character,
	-- while keeping orbit ON.

	OrbitOrigin =
		Root.Position

	OrbitAngle = 0

	task.wait(0.2)

	if OrbitEnabled
		and Root.Parent
	then

		Root.Anchored = true

	end

	UpdateUI()

end)

--========================================================
-- INITIAL UI
--========================================================

UpdateUI()

print("--------------------------------")
print("EVADE AFK LOADED")
print("Right Shift = Menu")
print("P = Orbit")
print("Orbit persists through respawns")
print("Auto Revive hold = 15 seconds")
print("--------------------------------")

scripts.title: Fluent Heart
scripts.script:
-- ==========================================
-- 1. RE-EXECUTION CLEANUP & STATE STORAGE
-- ==========================================
if _G.UniversalHubCleanup then
    pcall(_G.UniversalHubCleanup)
end

local connections = {}
local activeLoops = {true}

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

_G.OriginalLighting = _G.OriginalLighting or {
    Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
    Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
    GlobalShadows = true,
    FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
    FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
}

_G.OriginalGravity = workspace.Gravity
_G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom = LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance
_G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

Lighting.GlobalShadows = true

-- Spectate Tracer Cleanup Variables
local spectateBeam = nil
local spectateAtt0 = nil
local spectateAtt1 = nil

local function removeSpectateTracer()
    if spectateBeam then pcall(function() spectateBeam:Destroy() end) spectateBeam = nil end
    if spectateAtt0 then pcall(function() spectateAtt0:Destroy() end) spectateAtt0 = nil end
    if spectateAtt1 then pcall(function() spectateAtt1:Destroy() end) spectateAtt1 = nil end
end

-- Custom Highlight & Billboard Containers Cleanup
local customHighlightFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
customHighlightFolder.Name = "UniversalHub_CustomHighlights"
customHighlightFolder.Parent = workspace

local playerHighlights = {}
local npcHighlights = {}

local function clearAllCustomHighlights()
    if customHighlightFolder then
        customHighlightFolder:ClearAllChildren()
    end
    table.clear(playerHighlights)
    table.clear(npcHighlights)
end

_G.UniversalHubCleanup = function()
    activeLoops[1] = false
    
    for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
        if conn and conn.Connected then
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    table.clear(connections)

    removeSpectateTracer()
    clearAllCustomHighlights()
    if customHighlightFolder then customHighlightFolder:Destroy() end

    if workspace:FindFirstChild("UniversalFloatPlatform") then
        workspace.UniversalFloatPlatform:Destroy()
    end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam and LocalPlayer.Character then
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hum then
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
        elseif hrp then
            cam.CameraSubject = hrp
        end
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end

    if _G.OriginalLighting then
        Lighting.Brightness = _G.OriginalLighting.Brightness
        Lighting.Ambient = _G.OriginalLighting.Ambient
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = _G.OriginalLighting.GlobalShadows
        Lighting.FogEnd = _G.OriginalLighting.FogEnd
        Lighting.FogStart = _G.OriginalLighting.FogStart
    end

    workspace.Gravity = _G.OriginalGravity
    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight
    LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom

    if _G.FluentWindow then
        pcall(function() _G.FluentWindow:Destroy() end)
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 2. EXECUTOR TIER & ENVIRONMENT DETECTION
-- ==========================================
local executorName = "Unknown"
local executorVersion = "Unknown"

pcall(function()
    if identifyexecutor then
        executorName, executorVersion = identifyexecutor()
    elseif getexecutorname then
        executorName = getexecutorname()
    end
end)

local lowerExecutorName = string.lower(executorName)
local isLowLevelExecutor = (
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "xeno") or 
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "delta") or 
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "hydrogen") or
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "fluxus")
)

print("[FluentHeart]: Detected Executor -> " .. executorName .. " | Mode: " .. (isLowLevelExecutor and "Low-Level Compatibility Mode" or "Standard/Medium Mode"))

-- ==========================================
-- 3. SERVICES & CORE VARIABLES
-- ==========================================
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")

local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

-- Settings & Flags
local walkSpeedValue = 16
local jumpPowerValue = 50
local fovValue = 70

local customCameraZoomEnabled = false
local customCameraZoomValue = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom

local tpToolEnabled = false
local floatEnabled = false
local qeControlEnabled = true
local floatSpeedValue = 42
local floatBaseY = nil
local floatYOffset = -2

local potatoGraphicsEnabled = false
local fullbrightEnabled = false
local noFogEnabled = false

local customGravityEnabled = false
local customGravityValue = math.floor(_G.OriginalGravity)
local disableSlidingEnabled = false
local instantAirControlEnabled = false

local joinLogEnabled = false
local playerJoinTimes = {}

local lowHpTrackerEnabled = false
local deathListenerEnabled = false
local deathLogs = {}
local lowHpDebounce = {}

local spectatingPlayer = nil
local selectedTpPlayer = nil
local spawnCFrame = nil

-- Sound Configuration System
local soundSettings = {
    LowHP = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://4590657391" },
    PlayerLeft = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://9114220737" },
    General = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://9060817403" }
}

local function playCustomSound(category)
    pcall(function()
        local cfg = soundSettings[category] or soundSettings.General
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.SoundId = cfg.SoundId
        sound.Volume = cfg.Volume
        sound.Parent = SoundService
        sound:Play()
        game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound, 3)
    end)
end

local function recordSpawnLocation(char)
    local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    if hrp then
        task.wait(0.2)
        spawnCFrame = hrp.CFrame
    end
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    task.spawn(recordSpawnLocation, LocalPlayer.Character)
end
table.insert(connections, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(recordSpawnLocation))

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    playerJoinTimes[player] = tick()
end

table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    playerJoinTimes[player] = tick()
end))

local originalMaterials = {}
task.spawn(function()
    local parts = Workspace:GetDescendants()
    local yieldLimit = isLowLevelExecutor and 100 or 250
    for i = 1, #parts do
        local part = parts[i]
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            originalMaterials[part] = part.Material
        end
        if i % yieldLimit == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
end)

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
        originalMaterials[part] = part.Material
        if potatoGraphicsEnabled then
            part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        end
    end
end))

-- ==========================================
-- 4. HELPER FUNCTIONS & LOGIC
-- ==========================================

local function giveTeleportTool()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if not backpack then return end

    if backpack:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") or char:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") then return end

    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "Teleport Tool"
    tool.RequiresHandle = false

    tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and Mouse.Hit then
            local currentRotation = hrp.CFrame - hrp.CFrame.Position
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(Mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * currentRotation
        end
    end)

    tool.Parent = backpack
end

local floatPlatform = nil
local function updateFloatPlatform(dt)
    if not floatEnabled then
        if floatPlatform then
            floatPlatform:Destroy()
            floatPlatform = nil
        end
        floatBaseY = nil
        return
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if hrp and hum then
        local hipOffset = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) and (hum.HipHeight + 1.2) or 3.0
        local targetY = hrp.Position.Y - hipOffset

        if not floatBaseY then
            floatBaseY = targetY
        end

        if math.abs(targetY - floatBaseY) > 15 then
            floatBaseY = targetY
        end

        if hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
            if targetY > floatBaseY and (targetY - floatBaseY) < 12 then
                floatBaseY = targetY
            end
        else
            if math.abs(targetY - floatBaseY) > 0.5 then
                floatBaseY = targetY
            end
        end

        local verticalSpeed = floatSpeedValue * dt
        if qeControlEnabled then
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY + verticalSpeed
            elseif UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY - verticalSpeed
            end
        end

        if not floatPlatform or not floatPlatform.Parent then
            floatPlatform = Instance.new("Part")
            floatPlatform.Name = "UniversalFloatPlatform"
            floatPlatform.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
            floatPlatform.Anchored = true
            floatPlatform.CanCollide = true
            floatPlatform.Transparency = 0.9
            floatPlatform.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
            floatPlatform.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
            floatPlatform.Parent = Workspace
        end
        
        local finalY = floatBaseY + floatYOffset
        floatPlatform.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, finalY, hrp.Position.Z)
    end
end

local function isCharacterPart(part)
    local ancestor = part.Parent
    while ancestor and ancestor ~= Workspace do
        if ancestor:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            return true
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function stopSpectating()
    spectatingPlayer = nil
    removeSpectateTracer()

    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if cam and char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        if hum then
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
        elseif hrp then
            cam.CameraSubject = hrp
        end
        
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end
end

local function updateSpectateTracer()
    if not spectatingPlayer or not spectatingPlayer.Character or not LocalPlayer.Character then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        return
    end

    local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHRP = spectatingPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not myHRP or not targetHRP then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        return
    end

    if not spectateBeam or not spectateBeam.Parent then
        spectateAtt0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        spectateAtt0.Name = "SpectateAtt0"
        spectateAtt0.Parent = myHRP

        spectateAtt1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        spectateAtt1.Name = "SpectateAtt1"
        spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP

        spectateBeam = Instance.new("Beam")
        spectateBeam.Name = "SpectateTracer"
        spectateBeam.Attachment0 = spectateAtt0
        spectateBeam.Attachment1 = spectateAtt1
        spectateBeam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
        spectateBeam.Width0 = 0.05
        spectateBeam.Width1 = 0.05
        spectateBeam.FaceCamera = true
        spectateBeam.LightEmission = 1
        spectateBeam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
        spectateBeam.Parent = myHRP
    else
        if spectateAtt0 and spectateAtt0.Parent ~= myHRP then spectateAtt0.Parent = myHRP end
        if spectateAtt1 and spectateAtt1.Parent ~= targetHRP then spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 5. FLUENT & ADDONS INITIALIZATION
-- ==========================================
local successLoad, Fluent = false, nil

pcall(function()
    successLoad, Fluent = pcall(function()
        return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()
    end)
end)

if not successLoad or not Fluent then
    pcall(function()
        successLoad, Fluent = pcall(function()
            return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/master/main.lua"))()
        end)
    end)
end

if not successLoad or not Fluent then
    local httpRequest = (syn and syn.request) or request or http_request or (Fluxus and Fluxus.request)
    if httpRequest then
        pcall(function()
            local res = httpRequest({
                Url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/master/main.lua",
                Method = "GET"
            })
            if res and res.Body then
                successLoad, Fluent = pcall(loadstring(res.Body))
            end
        end)
    end
end

if not successLoad or not Fluent then
    warn("[FluentHeart]: Critical Error: Failed to load Fluent Library.")
    return
end

local SaveManager = nil
pcall(function()
    SaveManager = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/master/Addons/SaveManager.lua"))()
end)

local Window = Fluent:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Universal Client Hub (" .. (isLowLevelExecutor and "Lite/Xeno Mode" or "Full Mode") .. ")",
    SubTitle = "Fluent Edition",
    TabWidth = 160,
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(600, 480),
    Acrylic = not isLowLevelExecutor,
    Theme = "Dark"
})

_G.FluentWindow = Window

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        Window:Minimize()
    end
end))

local Tabs = {
    Player = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Local Player", Icon = "user" }),
    Players = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Players", Icon = "users" }),
    Visuals = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Visuals", Icon = "eye" }),
    Utilities = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Utilities & Tools", Icon = "wrench" }),
    Logs = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Server & Logs", Icon = "file-text" }),
    Config = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Config & Sound", Icon = "settings" }),
    Readme = Window:AddTab({ Title = "README", Icon = "book" })
}

-- ==========================================
-- 6. LOCAL PLAYER TAB
-- ==========================================

Tabs.Player:AddButton({
    Title = "Spawn TP",
    Description = "Teleports you back to where you spawned",
    Callback = function()
        local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myHRP and spawnCFrame then
            myHRP.CFrame = spawnCFrame
            playCustomSound("General")
            Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Teleported", Content = "Teleported back to spawn location.", Duration = 2 })
        else
            playCustomSound("General")
            Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Spawn Error", Content = "Spawn location not recorded yet.", Duration = 2 })
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSection("Movement & Modifiers")

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("WalkSpeedSlider", {
    Title = "WalkSpeed",
    Default = 16,
    Min = 16,
    Max = 250,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        walkSpeedValue = Value
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = Value end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("DisableSlidingToggle", {
    Title = "Disable Sliding",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        disableSlidingEnabled = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("JumpPowerSlider", {
    Title = "JumpPower",
    Default = 50,
    Min = 50,
    Max = 300,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        jumpPowerValue = Value
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.UseJumpPower = true
            hum.JumpPower = Value
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("GravityToggle", {
    Title = "Gravity",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        customGravityEnabled = Value
        workspace.Gravity = Value and customGravityValue or _G.OriginalGravity
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("GravitySlider", {
    Title = "Custom Gravity",
    Default = math.floor(_G.OriginalGravity),
    Min = 0,
    Max = math.floor(_G.OriginalGravity * 3),
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        customGravityValue = Value
        if customGravityEnabled then
            workspace.Gravity = Value
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("MaxSlopeToggle", {
    Title = "Max Slope Angle (360°)",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.MaxSlopeAngle = Value and 360 or 45
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("InstantAirControlToggle", {
    Title = "Disable Air Sliding",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        instantAirControlEnabled = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("NoVoidToggle", {
    Title = "No Void",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        if Value then
            workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -900000000000000000000000
        else
            workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight or -500
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("CameraZoomToggle", {
    Title = "Max Camera Distance",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        customCameraZoomEnabled = Value
        if Value then
            LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = customCameraZoomValue
        else
            LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("CameraMaxZoomSlider", {
    Title = "Camera Distance Max",
    Default = math.clamp(math.floor(_G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom), 0, 1280),
    Min = 0,
    Max = 1280,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        local stepValue = math.floor(Value / 10) * 10
        customCameraZoomValue = stepValue
        if customCameraZoomEnabled then
            LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = stepValue
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("FOVSlider", {
    Title = "Field of View",
    Default = 70,
    Min = 1,
    Max = 360,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        fovValue = Value
        Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("FloatToggle", {
    Title = "Float Platform",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        floatEnabled = Value
        floatBaseY = nil
        if not Value and floatPlatform then
            floatPlatform:Destroy()
            floatPlatform = nil
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("FloatOffsetSlider", {
    Title = "Platform Y-Level",
    Default = 0,
    Min = -5,
    Max = 5,
    Rounding = 1,
    Callback = function(Value)
        floatYOffset = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("FloatQEToggle", {
    Title = "Enable Holdable Q / E Player Movement Controls",
    Default = true,
    Callback = function(Value)
        qeControlEnabled = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("FloatSpeedSlider", {
    Title = "Float Q/E Speed",
    Default = 42,
    Min = 10,
    Max = 200,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        floatSpeedValue = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("TPToolToggle", {
    Title = "Give TP Tool",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        tpToolEnabled = Value
        if Value then giveTeleportTool() end
    end
})

-- ==========================================
-- 7. PLAYERS TAB
-- ==========================================

Tabs.Players:AddSection("Player Teleport & Spectate")

local spectateDropdown
local playerDropdown

playerDropdown = Tabs.Players:AddDropdown("PlayerTeleportDropdown", {
    Title = "Select Target Player to TP",
    Values = {"None"},
    Multi = false,
    Default = "None",
    Callback = function(Value)
        selectedTpPlayer = Value
        if Value and Value ~= "None" then
            local targetPlayer = Players:FindFirstChild(Value)
            if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
                local targetHRP = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if targetHRP and myHRP then
                    myHRP.CFrame = targetHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                    playCustomSound("General")
                    Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Teleported", Content = "Teleported to " .. targetPlayer.Name, Duration = 3 })
                end

local function bindCharacterTrackers(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    local function onCharacter(char)
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        if not hum or not hrp then return end

        table.insert(connections, hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
            if lowHpTrackerEnabled and health <= 35 and health > 0 then
                if not lowHpDebounce[player] then
                    lowHpDebounce[player] = true
                    playCustomSound("LowHP")
                    Fluent:Notify({
                        Title = "Low HP Alert",
                        Content = player.Name .. " is low! (" .. math.floor(health) .. " HP)",
                        Duration = 4
                    })
                end
            elseif health > 35 then
                lowHpDebounce[player] = nil
            end
        end))

        table.insert(connections, hum.Died:Connect(function()
            if deathListenerEnabled then
                local deathCF = hrp.CFrame
                local timeStr = os.date("%I:%M:%S %p")
                local label = string.format("%s Died [%s]", player.Name, timeStr)

                playCustomSound("General")
                Fluent:Notify({
                    Title = "Player Died",
                    Content = string.format("%s Died [%s]", player.Name, timeStr),
                    Duration = 4
                })

                table.insert(deathLogs, 1, {
                    name = player.Name,
                    cframe = deathCF,
                    label = label
                })

                if #deathLogs > 200 then
                    table.remove(deathLogs)
                end

                local labels = {}
                for _, entry in ipairs(deathLogs) do
                    table.insert(labels, entry.label)
                end
                deathDropdown:SetValues(labels)
            end
        end))
    end

    if player.Character then onCharacter(player.Character) end
    table.insert(connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter))
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    bindCharacterTrackers(player)
end

Tabs.Visuals:AddButton({
    Title = "Highlight Evaluated Paths (Through Walls)",
    Description = "Evaluates paths within range and places wall-penetrating highlights",
    Callback = function()
        for _, hl in ipairs(activePathHighlights) do
            if hl then hl:Destroy() end
        end
        table.clear(activePathHighlights)

        local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        local function evaluateAndHighlight(str)
            if not str or str == "" then return end
            pcall(function()
                local fn = loadstring("return " .. str)
                if fn then
                    local res = fn()
                    local targets = {}
                    if typeof(res) == "Instance" then
                        table.insert(targets, res)
                    elseif type(res) == "table" then
                        for _, item in pairs(res) do
                            if typeof(item) == "Instance" then
                                table.insert(targets, item)
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
                        if target:IsA("BasePart") or target:IsA("Model") then
                            local partToCheck = target:IsA("Model") and target.PrimaryPart or target
                            if partToCheck and myHRP then
                                local dist = (partToCheck.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                                if dist <= pathRangeLimit then
                                    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                                    highlight.Adornee = target
                                    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
                                    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                                    highlight.FillTransparency = pathHighlightTransparency
                                    highlight.OutlineTransparency = pathHighlightTransparency
                                    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                                    highlight.Parent = customHighlightFolder
                                    table.insert(activePathHighlights, highlight)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        evaluateAndHighlight(pathInputExpr)
        evaluateAndHighlight(pathInputProp)
        playCustomSound("General")
        Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Path Evaluated", Content = "Wall-penetrating highlights applied within range.", Duration = 3 })
    end
})

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- 1. Create ScreenGui automatically
local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "ShiftLockGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- 2. Create Shift Lock Toggle Button (Exact Icon & Style)
local shiftButton = Instance.new("ImageButton")
shiftButton.Name = "ShiftLockButton"
shiftButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
shiftButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0.5, -25) -- Middle-right screen area
shiftButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
shiftButton.Image = "rbxasset://textures/ui/mouseLock_off.png"
shiftButton.Parent = screenGui

-- 3. Create Center Crosshair Icon
local crosshair = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
crosshair.Name = "ShiftLockCrosshair"
crosshair.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32)
crosshair.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
crosshair.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
crosshair.BackgroundTransparency = 1
crosshair.Image = "rbxasset://textures/MouseLockedCursor.png"
crosshair.Visible = false
crosshair.Parent = screenGui

-- Textures
local TEXTURE_OFF = "rbxasset://textures/ui/mouseLock_off.png"
local TEXTURE_ON = "rbxasset://textures/ui/mouseLock_on.png"

local isShiftLocked = false

-- Toggle function
local function setShiftLock(enabled)
	isShiftLocked = enabled
	
	if isShiftLocked then
		shiftButton.Image = TEXTURE_ON
		crosshair.Visible = true
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	else
		shiftButton.Image = TEXTURE_OFF
		crosshair.Visible = false
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	end
end

-- Render loop for Camera & Character behavior
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not character then return end
	
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	
	if isShiftLocked and humanoid and rootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		
		-- Rotate player to face camera direction
		local cameraCFrame = Camera.CFrame
		local lookVector = Vector3.new(cameraCFrame.LookVector.X, 0, cameraCFrame.LookVector.Z)
		if lookVector.Magnitude > 0 then
			rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPart.Position, rootPart.Position + lookVector)
		end
		
		-- Shoulder camera offset
		Camera.CFrame = cameraCFrame * CFrame.new(1.75, 0.5, 0)
	else
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		end
	end
end)

-- Keyboard Input (Left Shift)
ContextActionService:BindAction("ToggleShiftLock", function(actionName, inputState)
	if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		setShiftLock(not isShiftLocked)
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end, false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)

-- Button click support (Mobile & PC Mouse)
shiftButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setShiftLock(not isShiftLocked)
end)

-- Reset state on respawn
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	setShiftLock(false)
end)

				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)

	end)

local function findJoint(...)

	for _, name in ipairs({...}) do

		if joints[name] then
			return joints[name]
		end

	end

	for _, object in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do

		if object:IsA("Motor6D") then

			local lower =
				object.Name:lower()

			for _, wanted in ipairs({...}) do

				if string.find(
					lower,
					wanted:lower(),
					1,
					true
				) then

					return object

				end

			end

		end

	end

	return nil

end

local function animateJoint(
	joint,
	cframe,
	weight
)

	if not joint then
		return
	end

	local original =
		originalTransforms[joint]

	if not original then
		original = CFrame.identity
	end

	joint.Transform =
		original:Lerp(
			original * cframe,
			weight or 1
		)

end

local function isGrounded()

	if humanoid.FloorMaterial
		~= Enum.Material.Air then

		return true

	end

	local result =
		workspace:Raycast(
			rigRoot.Position +
				Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0),
			Vector3.new(0, -4, 0),
			rayParams
		)

--------------------------------------------------
-- RAY
--------------------------------------------------

local function rayHit(direction, distance)

	if direction.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return nil
	end

	local origin =
		rigRoot.Position +
		Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)

	return workspace:Raycast(
		origin,
		direction.Unit * distance,
		rayParams
	)

end

--------------------------------------------------
-- BLOCKCAST
--------------------------------------------------

local function getHardObstacle(direction)

	if direction.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return nil
	end

	local flat =
		Vector3.new(
			direction.X,
			0,
			direction.Z
		)

	if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return nil
	end

	flat = flat.Unit

	local origin =
		rigRoot.Position +
		Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)

	return workspace:Blockcast(
		CFrame.lookAt(
			origin,
			origin + flat
		),
		BLOCKCAST_SIZE,
		flat * HARD_BLOCK_DISTANCE,
		rayParams
	)

end

--------------------------------------------------
-- WALL AVOIDANCE
--------------------------------------------------

local function getWallAvoidance(direction)

	if direction.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return direction
	end

	local forward =
		Vector3.new(
			direction.X,
			0,
			direction.Z
		)

	if forward.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return direction
	end

	forward = forward.Unit

	local right =
		Vector3.new(
			-forward.Z,
			0,
			forward.X
		)

	local left = -right

	local forwardHit =
		rayHit(
			forward,
			OBSTACLE_CHECK_DISTANCE
		)

	if not forwardHit then

		if turningAroundWall
			and wallTurnDirection
			and time() < wallTurnUntil then

			if not rayHit(
				wallTurnDirection,
				SIDE_CHECK_DISTANCE
			) then

				return (
					forward * 0.35 +
					wallTurnDirection * 0.65
				).Unit

			end

		end

		turningAroundWall = false
		wallTurnDirection = nil

		return forward

	end

	local leftHit =
		rayHit(
			left,
			SIDE_CHECK_DISTANCE
		)

	local rightHit =
		rayHit(
			right,
			SIDE_CHECK_DISTANCE
		)

	if not leftHit and not rightHit then

		wallTurnDirection =
			random:NextNumber() < 0.5
			and left
			or right

		turningAroundWall = true
		wallTurnUntil = time() + 1.5

		return (
			forward * 0.2 +
			wallTurnDirection * 0.8
		).Unit

	end

	if not leftHit then

		wallTurnDirection = left
		turningAroundWall = true
		wallTurnUntil = time() + 1.5

		return (
			forward * 0.2 +
			left * 0.8
		).Unit

	end

	if not rightHit then

		wallTurnDirection = right
		turningAroundWall = true
		wallTurnUntil = time() + 1.5

		return (
			forward * 0.2 +
			right * 0.8
		).Unit

	end

	local side =
		random:NextNumber() < 0.5
		and left
		or right

	return side.Unit

end

--------------------------------------------------
-- 🐸 JUMP
--------------------------------------------------

local function tryJump(force)

	if catIsDead
		or petting
		or jumping
		or humanoid.Health <= 0 then

		return false

	end

	if time() - lastJumpTime <
		JUMP_COOLDOWN then

		return false

	end

	if not force and not isGrounded() then
		return false
	end

	forceStand()

	lastJumpTime = time()
	jumping = true

	jumpStartedAt = time()
	jumpEndTime =
		time() + MAX_JUMP_TIME

	stopWalk()

	humanoid.JumpPower =
		RECOVERY_JUMP_POWER

	humanoid.Jump = true

	humanoid:ChangeState(
		Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
	)

	task.delay(
		JUMP_CONTROL_TIME,
		function()

			if rig.Parent
				and not catIsDead
				and humanoid.Health > 0 then

				humanoid.JumpPower =
					NORMAL_JUMP_POWER

			end

		end
	)

	return true

end

--------------------------------------------------
-- UPDATE JUMP
--------------------------------------------------

local function updateJump()

	if not jumping then
		return false
	end

	local now = time()

	if isGrounded()
		and now - jumpStartedAt >
		LANDING_BUFFER then

		jumping = false

		humanoid.JumpPower =
			NORMAL_JUMP_POWER

		return false

	end

	if now >= jumpEndTime then

		jumping = false

		humanoid.JumpPower =
			NORMAL_JUMP_POWER

		return false

	end

	humanoid:Move(
		Vector3.zero,
		false
	)

	return true

end

--------------------------------------------------
-- MOVE
--------------------------------------------------

local function moveDirection(direction, speed)

	if catIsDead
		or jumping
		or petting then

		return

	end

	if direction.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return
	end

	forceStand()

	local flat =
		Vector3.new(
			direction.X,
			0,
			direction.Z
		)

	if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return
	end

	flat = flat.Unit

	local hardHit =
		getHardObstacle(flat)

	if hardHit then

		local right =
			Vector3.new(
				-flat.Z,
				0,
				flat.X
			)

		local left = -right

		local leftBlocked =
			getHardObstacle(left) ~= nil

		local rightBlocked =
			getHardObstacle(right) ~= nil

		if leftBlocked
			and rightBlocked then

			if isGrounded() then

				if tryJump(false) then
					return
				end

			end

			humanoid:Move(
				Vector3.zero,
				false
			)

			stopWalk()

			return

		end

		if not leftBlocked then

			flat =
				(
					flat * 0.15 +
					left * 0.85
				).Unit

		elseif not rightBlocked then

			flat =
				(
					flat * 0.15 +
					right * 0.85
				).Unit

		end

	end

	local movement =
		getWallAvoidance(flat)

	if movement.Magnitude < 0.05 then

		humanoid:Move(
			Vector3.zero,
			false
		)

		stopWalk()

		return

	end

	humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed

	humanoid:Move(
		movement,
		false
	)

	playWalk()

end

	local current =
		rigRoot.Position

	local target =

	local difference =
		target - current

	if difference.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return

	rigRoot.CFrame =
		CFrame.lookAt(
			current,
			target

local function getRandomExplorePosition()

	for _ = 1, 15 do

		local angle =
			random:NextNumber(
				0,
				math.pi * 2
			)

		local distance =
			random:NextNumber(
				EXPLORE_MIN_DISTANCE,
				EXPLORE_MAX_DISTANCE
			)

		local offset =
			Vector3.new(
				math.cos(angle) * distance,
				0,
				math.sin(angle) * distance
			)

		local desired =
			playerRoot.Position +
			offset

		local ground =
			workspace:Raycast(
				desired +
					Vector3.new(0, 25, 0),
				Vector3.new(0, -50, 0),
				rayParams
			)

		if ground then

			return ground.Position +
				Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)

		end

	end

	return playerRoot.Position +
		Vector3.new(
			random:NextNumber(-10, 10),
			0,
			random:NextNumber(-10, 10)
		)

end

local function updateStuck(moving, dt)

	if jumping or petting then

		stuckTimer = 0
		lastStuckPosition =
			rigRoot.Position

		return

	end

	if not moving then

		stuckTimer = 0
		lastStuckPosition =
			rigRoot.Position

		return

	end

	local movement =
		(
			rigRoot.Position -
			lastStuckPosition
		).Magnitude

	if movement < STUCK_DISTANCE then

		stuckTimer += dt

	else

		stuckTimer = 0

		lastStuckPosition =
			rigRoot.Position

	end

	if stuckTimer >=
		STUCK_CHECK_TIME then

		stuckTimer = 0

		recovering = true

		recoveryUntil =
			time() + RECOVERY_TIME

		if isGrounded() then
			tryJump(true)
		end

	end

end

local highestFallY =
	rigRoot.Position.Y

local wasAirborne = false

local function updateDeathCause()

	if catIsDead then
		return
	end

	local velocity =
		rigRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity

	local speed =
		velocity.Magnitude

	local grounded =
		isGrounded()

	if not grounded then

		if not wasAirborne then

			wasAirborne = true
			highestFallY =
				rigRoot.Position.Y

		else

			highestFallY =
				math.max(
					highestFallY,
					rigRoot.Position.Y
				)

		end

	else

		if wasAirborne then

			local fallDistance =
				highestFallY -
				rigRoot.Position.Y

			if fallDistance >=
				HIGH_FALL_DISTANCE then

				deathCause =
					"Fall from height"

			end

		end

		wasAirborne = false

		highestFallY =
			rigRoot.Position.Y

	end

	if speed >=
		HIGH_SPEED_IMPACT then

		deathCause =
			"High-speed impact"

	end

end

local function ragdollCat()

	if not RAGDOLL_ON_DEATH
		or deathProcessed then

		return

	end

	deathProcessed = true

	if not rig.Parent then
		return
	end

	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
	humanoid.JumpPower = 0
	humanoid.PlatformStand = true

	pcall(function()

		humanoid:ChangeState(
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
		)

	end)

	--------------------------------------------------
	-- Create physical constraints
	--------------------------------------------------

	for _, joint in ipairs(
		rig:GetDescendants()
	) do

		if joint:IsA("Motor6D")
			and joint.Part0
			and joint.Part1 then

			local part0 =
				joint.Part0

			local part1 =
				joint.Part1

			local attachment0 =
				Instance.new("Attachment")

			attachment0.Name =
				"CatRagdollA0"

			attachment0.CFrame =
				joint.C0

			attachment0.Parent =
				part0

			local attachment1 =
				Instance.new("Attachment")

			attachment1.Name =
				"CatRagdollA1"

			attachment1.CFrame =
				joint.C1

			attachment1.Parent =
				part1

			local constraint =
				Instance.new(
					"BallSocketConstraint"
				)

			constraint.Name =
				"CatRagdollConstraint"

			constraint.Attachment0 =
				attachment0

			constraint.Attachment1 =
				attachment1

			constraint.LimitsEnabled = true
			constraint.UpperAngle = 45

			constraint.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
			constraint.TwistLowerAngle = -35
			constraint.TwistUpperAngle = 35

			constraint.Parent =
				part0

			joint.Enabled = false

		end

	end

	--------------------------------------------------
	-- Physical parts
	--------------------------------------------------

	for _, object in ipairs(
		rig:GetDescendants()
	) do

		if object:IsA("BasePart") then

			object.Anchored = false
			object.CanCollide = true
			object.CanTouch = true
			object.CanQuery = true
			object.Massless = false

			pcall(function()
				object.CollisionGroup = "Default"
			end)

		end

	end

	print(
		"☠️ Cat ragdolled. Cause: " ..
		tostring(deathCause)
	)

end

local function updateAge()

	if catIsDead then
		return
	end

	local age =
		time() - birthTime

	if age >= LIFE_TIME then

		deathCause = "Old age"

		catIsDead = true
		state = "DEAD"

		targetPosition = nil
		behaviorTarget = nil

		jumping = false
		petting = false
		recovering = false

		humanoid:Move(
			Vector3.zero,
			false
		)

		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false

		stopWalk()

		if petPrompt then
			petPrompt.Enabled = false
		end

		if sound then
			sound:Stop()
		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- Gentle non-graphic death transition
		--------------------------------------------------

		local started =
			time()

		local duration = 2.5

		task.spawn(function()

			while rig.Parent
				and time() - started <
				duration do

				local progress =
					math.clamp(
						(time() - started) /
							duration,
						0,
						1
					)

				local smooth =
					progress *
					progress *
					(3 - 2 * progress)

				animateJoint(
					leftShoulder,
					CFrame.Angles(
						math.rad(35) *
							smooth,
						0,
						math.rad(-8) *
							smooth
					),
					1
				)

				animateJoint(
					rightShoulder,
					CFrame.Angles(
						math.rad(35) *
							smooth,
						0,
						math.rad(8) *
							smooth
					),
					1
				)

				animateJoint(
					neck,
					CFrame.Angles(
						math.rad(15) *
							smooth,
						0,
						0
					),
					1
				)

				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

			end

			if rig.Parent then

				ragdollCat()

			end

		end)

		return

	end

	--------------------------------------------------
	-- GROWTH
	--------------------------------------------------

	local progress =
		math.clamp(
			age / LIFE_TIME,
			0,
			1
		)

	local smooth =
		progress *
		progress *
		(3 - 2 * progress)

	local newScale =
		START_SIZE +
		(FINAL_SIZE - START_SIZE) *
		smooth

	if math.abs(
		newScale - currentScale
	) > 0.001 then

		currentScale =
			newScale

		pcall(function()
			rig:ScaleTo(currentScale)
		end)

	end

end

local function chooseIdleBehavior()

	if petting
		or catIsDead then

		return

	end

	--------------------------------------------------
	-- Food gets special priority if nearby
	--------------------------------------------------

	if FOOD_ENABLED
		and random:NextNumber() <
		FOOD_SEARCH_CHANCE then

		if startFoodSearch() then
			return
		end

	end

	--------------------------------------------------
	-- Water
	--------------------------------------------------

	if WATER_ENABLED
		and random:NextNumber() <
		WATER_CHANCE then

		if startWaterSearch() then
			return
		end

	end

	--------------------------------------------------
	-- Chase
	--------------------------------------------------

	if CHASE_ENABLED
		and random:NextNumber() <
		CHASE_CHANCE then

		if startChasing() then
			return
		end

	end

	--------------------------------------------------
	-- Other behaviors
	--------------------------------------------------

	local roll =
		random:NextNumber()

	if roll < 0.13
		and SMELL_ENABLED then

		startSmelling()

	elseif roll < 0.23
		and GROOM_ENABLED then

		startGrooming()

	elseif roll < 0.31
		and PAW_ENABLED then

		startPawing()

	elseif roll < 0.38
		and STRETCH_ENABLED then

		startStretching()

	elseif roll < 0.46
		and WATCH_ENABLED then

		startWatching()

	elseif roll < 0.54
		and PLAY_ENABLED then

		startPlay()

	elseif roll < 0.62
		and RANDOM_RUN_ENABLED then

		startRandomRun()

	elseif roll < 0.88
		and EXPLORE_ENABLED then

		startExplore()

	else

		startIdle()

	end

end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(
	function(dt)

		if not rig.Parent
			or catIsDead
			or not character.Parent
			or not playerRoot.Parent
			or humanoid.Health <= 0 then

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- AGE
		--------------------------------------------------

		updateAge()

		if catIsDead then
			return
		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- DEATH DETECTION
		--------------------------------------------------

		updateDeathCause()

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- ANIMATION
		--------------------------------------------------

		updateLimbAnimation()

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- NEVER SIT
		--------------------------------------------------

		forceStand()

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- PET
		--------------------------------------------------

		if petting then

			updatePetting()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- JUMP
		--------------------------------------------------

		if updateJump() then
			return
		end

		local playerPosition =
			playerRoot.Position

		local distance =
			(
				rigRoot.Position -
				playerPosition
			).Magnitude

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- FLOOR SAFETY
		--------------------------------------------------

		if not isGrounded()
			and not jumping then

			tryJump(true)
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- FOOD SEARCH
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "SEARCHING_FOOD" then

			updateFoodSearch()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- EATING
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "EATING" then

			updateEating()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- WATER SEARCH
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "SEARCHING_WATER" then

			updateWaterSearch()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- DRINKING
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "DRINKING" then

			updateDrinking()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- SNIFF
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "SMELLING" then

			updateSmelling()

			if distance >
				FOLLOW_RESUME_DISTANCE then

				state = "FOLLOWING"
			end

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- GROOM
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "GROOMING" then

			updateGrooming()

			if distance >
				FOLLOW_RESUME_DISTANCE then

				state = "FOLLOWING"
			end

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- PAW
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "PAWING" then

			updatePawing()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- STRETCH
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "STRETCHING" then

			updateStretching()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- WATCH
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "WATCHING" then

			updateWatching()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- PLAY
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "PLAYING" then

			updatePlaying()

			if distance > 25 then
				state = "FOLLOWING"
			end

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- CHASE
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "CHASING" then

			updateChasing()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- RANDOM RUN
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "RUNNING_RANDOM" then

			updateRandomRun(
				playerPosition
			)

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- EXPLORE
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "WANDERING" then

			updateExplore(
				playerPosition
			)

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- RECOVERY
		--------------------------------------------------

		if recovering then

			if time() <
				recoveryUntil then

				moveDirection(
					playerPosition -
						rigRoot.Position,
					WALK_SPEED
				)

				updateStuck(
					true,
					dt
				)

				return

			else

				recovering = false

			end

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- TOO FAR
		--------------------------------------------------

		if distance >=
			TOO_FAR_DISTANCE then

			state = "RUNNING"

			moveDirection(
				playerPosition -
					rigRoot.Position,
				RUN_SPEED
			)

			updateStuck(true, dt)

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- RUNNING
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "RUNNING" then

			if distance <=
				RUN_DISTANCE then

				state = "FOLLOWING"

				humanoid.WalkSpeed =
					WALK_SPEED

				return

			end

			moveDirection(
				playerPosition -
					rigRoot.Position,
				RUN_SPEED
			)

			updateStuck(true, dt)

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- FOLLOWING
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "FOLLOWING" then

			if distance <=
				STOP_DISTANCE then

				stopMoving()

				humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0

				lookAt(playerPosition)

				if random:NextNumber()
					< 0.012 then

					chooseIdleBehavior()

				end

				return

			end

			moveDirection(
				playerPosition -
					rigRoot.Position,
				WALK_SPEED
			)

			updateStuck(true, dt)

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- IDLE
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "IDLE" then

			stopMoving()

			humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0

			lookAt(playerPosition)

			if distance >
				FOLLOW_RESUME_DISTANCE then

				state = "FOLLOWING"

				humanoid.WalkSpeed =
					WALK_SPEED

				return

			end

			if time() >= stateUntil then

				chooseIdleBehavior()

			end

			return

		end

	end
)

--------------------------------------------------
-- 🔄 PLAYER RESPAWN
--------------------------------------------------

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(
	function(newCharacter)

		character = newCharacter

		local newRoot =
			newCharacter:WaitForChild(
				"HumanoidRootPart"
			)

		playerRoot = newRoot

		rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
			rig,
			character
		}

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- CAT DOES NOT RESET
		--------------------------------------------------

		if rig.Parent
			and not catIsDead then

			jumping = false
			recovering = false
			petting = false

			behaviorTarget = nil

			rig:PivotTo(
				newRoot.CFrame *
				CFrame.new(
					0,
					0,
					-SPAWN_DISTANCE
				)
			)

			state = "FOLLOWING"

			targetPosition = nil

			humanoid.JumpPower =
				NORMAL_JUMP_POWER

			humanoid.WalkSpeed =
				WALK_SPEED

			humanoid.AutoRotate = true

			forceStand()

			if petPrompt then
				petPrompt.Enabled = true
			end

		end

	end
)

--------------------------------------------------
-- ☠️ HUMANOID DEATH
--------------------------------------------------

humanoid.Died:Connect(
	function()

		if catIsDead then
			return
		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- Determine cause
		--------------------------------------------------

		if deathCause == "Unknown" then

			local velocity =
				rigRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			if velocity.Magnitude >=
				HIGH_SPEED_IMPACT then

				deathCause =
					"High-speed impact"

			else

				deathCause =
					"Unexpected accident"

			end

		end

		catIsDead = true
		state = "DEAD"

		jumping = false
		petting = false
		recovering = false

		targetPosition = nil
		behaviorTarget = nil

		humanoid:Move(
			Vector3.zero,
			false
		)

		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
		humanoid.JumpPower = 0
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false

		stopWalk()

		if petPrompt then
			petPrompt.Enabled = false
		end

		if sound then
			sound:Stop()
		end

		task.defer(function()

			if rig.Parent then
				ragdollCat()
			end

		end)

		print(
			"☠️ Cat died from: " ..
			tostring(deathCause)
		)

	end
)

--------------------------------------------------
-- 🛡️ ANTI-STUCK / COLLISION
--------------------------------------------------

task.spawn(function()

	while rig.Parent
		and not catIsDead do

		task.wait(0.15)

		if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			break
		end

		forceStand()

		for _, object in ipairs(
			rig:GetDescendants()
		) do

			if object:IsA("BasePart") then

				object.Anchored = false
				object.CanCollide = true
				object.CanTouch = true
				object.CanQuery = true
				object.Massless = false

				pcall(function()
					object.CollisionGroup =
						"Default"
				end)

			end

		end

		if not jumping
			and not petting
			and state ~= "IDLE"
			and state ~= "SMELLING"
			and state ~= "GROOMING"
			and state ~= "PAWING"
			and state ~= "WATCHING"
			and state ~= "EATING"
			and state ~= "DRINKING"
			and state ~= "STRETCHING" then

			local velocity =
				rigRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			local moving =
				humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude
				> 0.2

			if velocity.Magnitude < 0.15
				and moving
				and isGrounded() then

				tryJump(true)

			end

		end

	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
